_doc: The Stray Kids easter egg (src/stray_kids.py, src/game_stray_kids.py). On one floor from first_floor to last_floor (every run: chance_per_run 1.0) a gold shrine to the K-pop band Stray Kids stands in a room (fixture sk_idol, data/fixtures.json). Walking into it says what it is; walking into it again touches it, and the hero is taken to the Zombie Stage (boss_levels.STRAY_KIDS_STAGE), a side floor like the Cow Level: never depth, never the Road. There the eight members dance as zombies (data/monsters.json sk_zombie_*), a war-band led by Bang Chan (data/war_bands.json stray_kids). They move as one formation: the dance's anchor closes on the hero and its shape changes every beats_per_shape beats, and a member strikes only on the downbeat (every strike_every beats). They leave no corpse, and the last to fall leaves the Autographed Stray Kids Photo (data/items/scroll.json). Read (one grammar question), the photo is spent and the band, alive, dances round the hero for stars.dance_turns turns: no blows on either side, and every monster near them stops to watch (stunned), except named foes and the mindless. NO REAL LYRICS ANYWHERE: every line here is made up; song titles are named only as titles. Facts checked on Grokipedia, then Wikipedia (2026-11-13).

idol.first_bump: The gold is warm, and a bass beat thumps somewhere. Walk into it again to touch it.
touch: You touch the idol. Eight voices count you in: "Five, six, seven, EIGHT!"
A spotlight swallows you, and the dungeon falls away.
idol.spent_bump: The gold has gone dull and the glitter has fallen off. The encore is over.
idol.touch_chronicle: I touched a gold statue of a K-pop band, twice, on purpose. A spotlight took me somewhere with a stage. I have nobody to blame but myself.

arrival: You stand in the wings of a stage. Lights blaze, and a bass beat shakes the floor.
Out there, eight voices are warming up, and none of them is breathing.
atmosphere: A fog machine coughs out grave-mist.
Rows of lightsticks glow in the dark seats like fireflies.
The empty seats chant: STAY! STAY! STAY!
stage.seen: The spotlights swing onto you. Eight dead heads turn as one. The music kicks in.
stage.door_line: The stage door is the way out (> on it).
stage.leave_cleared: You slip out through the stage door. Behind you, the lights go down. The show is over.
stage.leave_unfinished: You slip out through the stage door. Behind you, the music cuts off mid-chorus, and the door will not open again.
stage.leave_chronicle: I walked out on a zombie concert halfway through. I regret nothing.
stage.cleared_chronicle: I sat through an entire zombie Stray Kids concert, and fought it, and won. I am going to hear that bass line in my sleep.
stage.tell: Their songs get stuck in your head: they can confuse you, and a few can put you to sleep, stun or blind you for a moment. Keep your distance from the singers, or end it fast. Holy power and fire hurt them most.

shape_lines.v: The band snaps into a V, Bang Chan at its point.
shape_lines.two_rows: The band splits into two neat rows.
shape_lines.diamond: The band spins into a diamond round I.N.
shape_lines.column: The band falls into a single file, one behind another, every head bobbing.
shape_lines.line: The band spreads out in one long line across the stage.

dance.beat_tell: They move to the beat, and strike only on the downbeat.

band: STAY! STAY forever! No, really. STAY. We locked the doors.
Hands up! Hands UP! ...his fell off. Hand up!
This one's called "Maniac"! Because that's you, swinging at us!
Next song: "Thunderous"! Like our footsteps! On you!
We're Stray Kids! The stray part is old news. The zombie part is new.
Is this the encore? It's always the encore. It will always be the encore.
Fan chant! Everybody! You're not chanting! Why aren't you chanting?
"Back Door"! There is one. We're standing in front of it.
Welcome to "Miroh"! That means maze! You're in it!
"S-Class"! That's our rank. Yours is... D, maybe.
bang_chan: Okay, okay, one more take. From the top!
You're doing amazing! Keep fighting! Not us, though!
lee_know: My cats dance better than you.
Soonie? Doongie? Dori? ...this is the wrong dungeon.
changbin: I am DARK. I am SCARY. ...Do you like my bunny keyring?
Look at these arms. LOOK at them. They're falling off, but LOOK.
hyunjin: *flips his hair, slowly, so you notice*
*whistles a tune you will hum for a week*
Hold still. I want to paint you. Mostly in grave-green.
Is the wind machine on? Somebody turn on the wind machine.
felix: *says, in a voice like an earthquake: "hello."*
I baked brownies! They're a little bit undead.
HI-YAH! ...did that hurt? No? Okay. HI-YAH!
seungmin: Strike three. You're out. Of hit points.
I could do this all day. I HAVE done this all day. We've been dead a while.
i_n: Stop protecting me, I'm an ADULT zombie!
*warbles an old trot ballad like a grandma at church*
Hyung, I can fight my own battles! ...Hyung?

lines: Zombie Lee Know stops to scratch his cat behind the ears. You are less important than the cat.
Zombie Lee Know turns his back on you to check that the cat is comfortable.
Zombie Lee Know holds the cat up to admire it. It ignores him. He looks delighted.

observe.bang_chan: The rings under his eyes are older than the zombie thing. He keeps glancing back to check that the other seven are all right.
observe.lee_know: He holds the cat between you and him, and you are not sure which of them he is protecting.
observe.changbin: Dressed head to toe in black and flexing at nobody. Every few seconds the scary face slips and something adorable leaks out.
observe.hyunjin: He keeps flicking his hair back over one shoulder, slowly, so that you notice. You notice.
observe.han: His cheeks are puffed out round as a quokka's. Something crunches in there when he raps.
observe.felix: He is about the size of a large houseplant, and he is giving you his scariest martial-arts stance. It is adorable.
observe.seungmin: A puppyish face and a pitcher's arm. He is looking you up and down, and he clearly has notes on your outfit.
observe.i_n: The youngest. The other seven keep shuffling round so that he is always in the middle, and he keeps rolling his eyes about it.

disintegrate: {name} crumbles into glitter and grave-dust. Nothing is left of him.
last_falls: The last of the band crumbles away. In the drifting glitter, something flutters to the floor.
photo_drop: An Autographed Stray Kids Photo lies where the band last stood.

summon: You read the eight signatures aloud, one by one. The photo crumbles into glitter in your hands...
...and Stray Kids burst out of it in full stage gear, alive, grinning and glittering. The music starts.
lines: Thank you, dungeon! We love you!
Everybody clap! Clap! Not you, monsters, you just watch.
One more time! From the top!
stars.bow: The Stray Kids take a bow, wave, and vanish in a burst of confetti.
stars.chronicle: I read the names on a signed photo and the whole of Stray Kids came out of it and put on a show. Every monster in the room stopped to watch. So did I, a little.
stars.observe: He is in the middle of a show and having the time of his life. He will be gone in a few turns.
